name: Pelican Slip
tagline: Run your docks without drowning in paperwork.
positioning: Slip assignments, waitlists, and invoices for small marinas and the people who somehow got put in charge of them.

hero.h1: Your marina runs on a whiteboard. That's adorable.
hero.sub: Pelican Slip handles slip assignments, the waitlist nobody wants to admit exists, and the invoices your uncle keeps forgetting to send. One screen. No sea shanties.

features.title: Drag-a-boat slip map
features.description: A live map of every finger, T-head, and mooring ball. Drag a vessel to a slip and the paperwork writes itself. Double-booking is now impossible, not just frowned upon.

features.title: The waitlist, weaponized
features.description: Stop losing the sticky note. Rank applicants by loyalty, boat length, and how many times they've called. Auto-notify the next in line when a slip frees up.

features.title: Invoices that actually leave
features.description: Metered power, storage, pump-outs, and that one guy's kayak rack — billed automatically. ACH and card payments hit your account before he finds an excuse.

features.title: Weather-aware alerts
features.description: Small craft advisory rolling in? Blast every liveaboard and transient with one tap. Log who acknowledged it, for when the insurance adjuster asks.

features.title: Fuel & pump-out log
features.description: Track every gallon and every gray tank without a clipboard glued to the dock. Reconcile the fuel dock at close instead of at midnight.

features.title: Occupancy you can prove
features.description: Real numbers on turnover, seasonal vs. transient, and revenue per foot — so your dock expansion pitch stops being a vibe.

testimonials.quote: We ran 88 slips off a laminated spreadsheet and my memory. Pelican Slip found four boats we'd been letting stay for free since 2019. It paid for itself by Tuesday.
testimonials.name: Dana Okafor

testimonials.quote: The waitlist tool ended a decade-long feud between two members who both thought they were next for B-14. I sent one email and it was over. Genuinely miraculous.
testimonials.name: Rich Vandermolen

testimonials.quote: I inherited the marina from my dad and a shoebox of receipts. Now I invoice from my phone while the boat's still fueling. My accountant almost cried.
testimonials.name: Priya Castellano
